title: Radio cards and checkbox groups
when: The user wants options shown as selectable cards or grouped checkboxes, such as plan choice, shipping method or interests.
inputs: the options with title and short description
prompt:
Goal: Native radios and checkboxes styled as cards, grouped with a legend, with visible focus and checked states.
Steps:
1. <fieldset> with a <legend>; each option is <label class="card"><input type="radio" name="ship" value="express"> title and one line</label>.
2. Keep the input visible or visually hidden but focusable; style the card with .card:has(:checked) and .card:has(:focus-visible).
3. Show the checked state with a thicker border plus a check icon, not color alone.
4. Checkbox groups with a minimum: call setCustomValidity on the first box until one is checked.
5. A Select all checkbox sets indeterminate when only some are checked.
6. Lay cards out with repeat(auto-fit, minmax(12rem, 1fr)).
Quality bar:
- Arrow keys move between radios natively.
- The whole card is clickable.
- Descriptions are short and comparable.
Pitfalls:
- display: none on the inputs, killing keyboard use.
- Divs with click handlers instead of inputs.
- Radios with different name attributes in one group.
Verify:
- [ ] Every input sits inside or is pointed to by a label.
- [ ] Each group has a fieldset and legend.
- [ ] Checked and focus states are visible.
- [ ] Cards stack at 375 px.
Output: Group markup in the form and choices.css, plus a small script only for the select all and minimum rules.

examples.input: opcoes de frete em cartoes: normal, expresso, retirada
examples.output: fieldset Shipping method, three radio cards with price and days, :has(:checked) border and check icon
